'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 James Barnes LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
